notes.title: Fear & Hope - Devlog Update #5
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44884249/dc0015af6b5d4e751fe63d6c3c525aa90c07fa1f.png"]



Hi all,  



We're having fun out there and hope you are as well.  



Super excited to announce that we have officially completed the last 3D model clue of the game. A massive milestone for us that has been 18 months in the making!! 🚀🍾 



This brings us significantly closer to release of the game which we are targetting towards the end of this year.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44884249/efb94f94d040fe6ac2af59749a4967a18f7e9770.png"]

Expect to hear more from us soon!



All the best, 

The IS Team

notes.title: Fear & Hope - Devlog Update #4
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44884249/8da2224a50233088875b1066dbfcc099b827421b.png"]



Hi all,  



We're having fun out there and hope you are to.  



In the latest devlog video we've introduced a new weapon management system and battle mechanic for a range of enemies and monsters that are coming to the game. 



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44884249/8316daf1a43b46a8d2adb8ab038fc18973e8d935.png"]



But that's not all! We've also added another new feature around a food and water game mechanic that has survivalist elements. You'll need to find (or stumble upon) food and water throughout your journey otherwise you may not make it.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44884249/4ec0ce4c66177cd53406d4c6f066f710129e69fc.png"]



Stay tuned for more updates!



All the best, 

The IS Team

notes.title: Fear & Hope - Devlog Update #3
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44884249/03eb7db18e0c1f830c928a611313f41f87dbea31.png"]



Hi all,  



Hope you're having fun out there.  



BIG MILESTONE we have completed development of all 3D mini-game puzzles!! 🍾🎉

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44884249/635d6beab49fb6d37050e3b566d8db8adbb248e4.gif"]



We continue on the long pole in the tent which is a significant backlog of 2D art the game still needs for a full release, plus a little more story writing, music and some finishing touches on sound effects.



We are making progress though and getting closer each week which is very exciting.



Stay tuned for more updates!



Yours, 

The IS Team

notes.title: Fear & Hope - Devlog Update #2
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44884249/eadbaeb77dfdb91709d803e5f49c7800b4f772c0.png"]Hi all,

Hope you're having fun out there.

The devlog continues! We are close to wrapping up development of all 3D mini-game puzzles in the game which is a huge milestone for us as every puzzle is like completeing a mini-project!

A short gif from one of the puzzles we have been working on. We'll call it "Maestro Please" for now:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44884249/2644e925d61b2b96e28e96abc668e702e418eace.gif"]Until next time.

Love and Respect,
The IS Team

notes.title: Fear & Hope Free Demo Update Released!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44884249/b6e2030bf8540d8c9ea55d52244483e108819b15.png

Hi folks,

Hope you're having fun out there.

We've shipped a small update to the Fear & Hope Free Demo with some bug fixes and other bits and bobs. Latest version available on Steam is now v1.1, Build 6.

Check it out and let us know what you think!

Cheers,
Joel
